'''Tazenia Nerenhald''' was one a powerful noble in the [[Free Years]].

==History==
Tazenia Narenhald was one of three powerful nobles who seized control of [[Tanchico]] during the [[War of the Hundred Years]] and founded the kingdom of [[Tarabon]] around it. She served as the first Queen of Tarabon from {{Fy|1006}} onwards.
